description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC REST controller for handling order-related API endpoints within an e-commerce application. It includes methods for creating orders, listing all orders, and listing orders by a specific customer, with configuration for request parameters, error handling, and interaction with service layer components.

classes.name: OrderRESTController
classes.description: A Spring MVC REST controller managing order-related API endpoints for creating and retrieving orders within a merchant store context.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new order, including customer creation and order population.

methods.name: listOrders
methods.description: Overloaded GET method to list orders for a store or for a specific customer, with language and pagination support.
